tools.name: sprawdz_regon

tools.name: szukaj_pkd

tools.name: oblicz_odsetki
tools.description: Calculate statutory or commercial (B2B) late-payment interest, broken down by NBP reference-rate periods.

tools.name: szukaj_katalog_api

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: observe_nip · Private data: observe_nip, unobserve_nip, list_observations, changes_since, set_webhook · Public sink: observe_nip, set_webhook · Destructive: unobserve_nip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: observe_nip · Private data: observe_nip, unobserve_nip, list_observations, changes_since, set_webhook · Public sink: observe_nip, set_webhook · Destructive: unobserve_nip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
